requirements: An NVIDIA GPU with CUDA support is required.
Recommended: We recommend using a GPU with 80GB of memory for better generation quality.
We recommend CUDA versions 12.6 or 11.8 for the manual installation.

steps.title: Installation Guide for Linux
steps.code:
# 1. Create conda environment
conda create -n HunyuanVideo python==3.10.9

# 2. Activate the environment
conda activate HunyuanVideo

# 3. Install PyTorch
# For CUDA 11.8
pip install torch==2.7.1 torchvision==0.22.1 torchaudio==2.7.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu118
# For CUDA 12.6
pip install torch==2.7.1 torchvision==0.22.1 torchaudio==2.7.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu126

# 4. Install pip dependencies
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# 5. Install flash attention v2 for acceleration (requires CUDA 11.8 or above)
python -m pip install ninja
python -m pip install git+https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention.git@v2.8.3

# 6. Install xDiT for parallel inference (It is recommended to use torch 2.7.1 and flash-attn 2.8.3)
python -m pip install xfuser==0.4.0

# Option 1: Making sure you have installed CUDA 12.4, CUBLAS>=12.4.5.8, and CUDNN>=9.00 (or simply using our CUDA 12 docker image).
pip install nvidia-cublas-cu12==12.4.5.8
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/conda/lib/python3.8/site-packages/nvidia/cublas/lib/

# Option 2: Forcing to explictly use the CUDA 11.8 compiled version of Pytorch and all the other packages
pip uninstall -r requirements.txt  # uninstall all packages
pip uninstall -y xfuser
pip install torch==2.7.1 torchvision==0.22.1 torchaudio==2.7.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu118
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install ninja
pip install git+https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention.git@v2.8.3
pip install xfuser==0.4.0

# For CUDA 12.4 (updated to avoid float point exception)
docker pull hunyuanvideo/hunyuanvideo:cuda_12
docker run -itd --gpus all --init --net=host --uts=host --ipc=host --name hunyuanvideo --security-opt=seccomp=unconfined --ulimit=stack=67108864 --ulimit=memlock=-1 --privileged hunyuanvideo/hunyuanvideo:cuda_12

# For CUDA 11.8
docker pull hunyuanvideo/hunyuanvideo:cuda_11
docker run -itd --gpus all --init --net=host --uts=host --ipc=host --name hunyuanvideo --security-opt=seccomp=unconfined --ulimit=stack=67108864 --ulimit=memlock=-1 --privileged hunyuanvideo/hunyuanvideo:cuda_11

steps.title: Using Command Line
steps.code:
cd HunyuanVideo

python3 sample_video.py \
    --video-size 720 1280 \
    --video-length 129 \
    --infer-steps 50 \
    --prompt "A cat walks on the grass, realistic style." \
    --flow-reverse \
    --use-cpu-offload \
    --save-path ./results

steps.title: Run a Gradio Server
steps.code:
python3 gradio_server.py --flow-reverse

# set SERVER_NAME and SERVER_PORT manually
# SERVER_NAME=0.0.0.0 SERVER_PORT=8081 python3 gradio_server.py --flow-reverse

steps.title: Using Command Line
steps.code:
cd HunyuanVideo

torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 sample_video.py \
    --video-size 1280 720 \
    --video-length 129 \
    --infer-steps 50 \
    --prompt "A cat walks on the grass, realistic style." \
    --flow-reverse \
    --seed 42 \
    --ulysses-degree 8 \
    --ring-degree 1 \
    --save-path ./results

zh.what: 腾讯混元开源的大规模视频生成模型框架，包含模型权重、推理代码和面向大模型的工程优化，主线是文生视频，也被大量衍生工作拿去做图生视频和风格化。它的定位是基座而不是产品：下游的 LoRA 微调、ComfyUI 节点和各种二创工具常把它当底模，生态里的教程和插件围绕它生长。评估它主要看显存门槛、出片质量和许可条款，上手要能读 Python 脚本、会配环境、会下权重。
